name: EPIC 201805179
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 10.3 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201805179 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.311736 (16th-84th percentiles 10.007815-10.675237), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,286 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.89 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,887 K at its surface.
